arxiv-2010-15030.title: Actris 2.0: Asynchronous Session-Type Based Reasoning in Separation Logic
arxiv-2010-15030.creator: Jonas Kastberg Hinrichsen \rsuper a, Jesper Bengtson \rsuper b, Robbert Krebbers \rsuper c
arxiv-2010-15030.description: Abstract . Message passing is a useful abstraction for implementing concurrent programs. For real-world systems, however, it is often combined with other programming and concurrency paradigms, such as higher-order functions, mutable state, shared-memory concurrency, and locks. We present Actris : a logic for proving functional correctness of programs that use a combination of the aforementioned features.

arxiv-2108-06832.creator: Xueqing Yan, Yongming Li, Sanjiang Li
arxiv-2108-06832.description: Abstract The tile-based multiplayer game Mahjong is widely played in Asia and has also become increasingly popular worldwide. Face-to-face or online, each player begins with a hand of 13 tiles and players draw and discard tiles in turn until they complete a winning hand. arxiv-2205-03275.title: A free boundary problem in thermal insulation with a prescribed heat source
arxiv-2205-03275.creator: P. Acampora, E. Cristoforoni, C. Nitsch, C. Trombetti
arxiv-2205-03275.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by P. Acampora, E. Cristoforoni, C. Nitsch, C. Trombetti. We study the thermal insulation of a bounded body Ω ⊂ ℝ n \Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{n} , under a prescribed heat source f > 0 f>0 , via a bulk layer of insulating material. We consider a model of heat transfer between the insulated body and the environment determined by convection; this corresponds to Robin boundary conditions on the free boundary of the layer. We show that a minimal configuration exists and that it satisfies uniform density estimates.

arxiv-2304-04568.title: Synchronous control study of Chua circuit system via capacitive closed-loop coupling
arxiv-2304-04568.creator: Jiyuan Zhang, Xiao-Yun Wang
arxiv-2304-04568.description: Abstract Synchronous control of nonlinear circuits is of great importance in many fields. In this paper, a capacitor is used for closed-loop coupling of three dual-vortex attractor Chua circuits with the same circuit parameters and different initial conditions, and the corresponding synchronization processes and synchronization effects are investigated.

arxiv-2306-04179.title: Photon Reconstruction in the Belle II Calorimeter Using Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2306-04179.creator: F. Wemmer, I. Haide, J. Eppelt, T. Ferber, A. Beaubien, P. Branchini, M. Campajola, C. Cecchi, P. Cheema, G. De Nardo, C. Hearty, A. Kuzmin, S. Longo, E. Manoni, F. Meier, M. Merola, K. Miyabayashi, S. Moneta, M. Remnev, J. M. Roney, J.-G. Shiu, B. Shwartz, Y. Unno, R. van Tonder, R. Volpe
arxiv-2306-04179.description: Abstract We present the study of a fuzzy clustering algorithm for the Belle II electromagnetic calorimeter using Graph Neural Networks. We use a realistic detector simulation including simulated beam backgrounds and focus on the reconstruction of both isolated and overlapping photons.

arxiv-2505-16649.title: Stochastic Forward-Forward Learning through Representational Dimensionality Compression
arxiv-2505-16649.creator: Zhichao Zhu
arxiv-2505-16649.description: Abstract The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm provides a bottom-up alternative to backpropagation (BP) for training neural networks, relying on a layer-wise "goodness" function to guide learning. Existing goodness functions, inspired by energy-based learning (EBL), are typically defined as the sum of squared post-synaptic activations, neglecting the correlations between neurons.

arxiv-2507-14182.title: From Bias to Behavior: Learning Bull-Bear Market Dynamics with Contrastive Modeling
arxiv-2507-14182.creator: Xiaotong Luo, Shengda Zhuo, Min Chen, Lichun Li, Ruizhao Lu, Wenqi Fan, Shuqiang Huang, Yin Tang
arxiv-2507-14182.description: Abstract Financial markets exhibit highly dynamic and complex behaviors shaped by both historical price trajectories and exogenous narratives, such as news, policy interpretations, and social media sentiment. The heterogeneity in these data and the diverse insight of investors introduce biases that complicate the modeling of market dynamics.

arxiv-2511-02117.title: Ultra-Relativistic Freeze-Out: A Bridge from WIMPs to FIMPs Preprint: UMN–TH–4513/25, FTPI–MINN–25/15
arxiv-2511-02117.creator: Stephen E. Henrich, Yann Mambrini, Keith A. Olive
arxiv-2511-02117.description: Abstract We re-examine the case for dark matter (DM) produced by ultra-relativistic freeze-out (UFO). UFO is the mechanism by which Standard Model (SM) neutrinos decouple from the radiation bath in the early universe at a temperature T d ≈ 1 T_{d}\approx 1 MeV.

arxiv-2511-09031.title: Cosmological Inflation in f ⁡ ( Q , ℒ m ) f(Q,\mathcal{L}_{m}) Gravity
arxiv-2511-09031.creator: Maryam Shiravand, Saeed Fakhry, Javad T. Firouzjaee, Ali Tizfahm
arxiv-2511-09031.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maryam Shiravand, Saeed Fakhry, Javad T. Firouzjaee, Ali Tizfahm. Cosmological inflation remains a key paradigm for explaining the earliest stages of the Universe, yet the theoretical limitations of General Relativity (GR) motivate the development of alternative formulations capable of addressing both early and late cosmic acceleration. In this work, we investigate cosmological inflation within the f ⁡ ( Q , ℒ m ) f(Q,\mathcal{L}_{m}) gravity framework based on symmetric teleparallel geometry, where the non-metricity scalar Q Q couples directly to the matter Lagrangian.

pmc-10571018.title: Ba2−xHoxSr2−yNiyFe12O22 and its composite with MXene: synthesis, characterization and enhanced visible light mediated photocatalytic activity for colored dye and pesticide
pmc-10571018.creator: Beriham Basha, Alina Manzoor, Z. A. Alrowaili, Ayesha Ihsan, Imran Shakir, M. S. Al-Buriahi
pmc-10571018.description: The rapid recombination of charges of photogenerated electrons and holes severely limits single semiconductor photocatalytic applications. In this study, a simple and facile sol–gel approach was used to synthesize Ba2−xHoxSr2−yNiyFe12O22 (x = 0, 0.1 and y = 0, 0.5). The composite of holmium–nickel doped barium–strontium ferrite with MXene (Ba1.9Ho0.1Sr1.5Ni0.5Fe12O22@MXene) was synthesized by ultrasonication method.

pmc-11478107.title: Rapid Assessment of Sulfate Resistance in Mortar and Concrete
pmc-11478107.creator: Seyedsaleh Mousavinezhad, William K Toledo, Craig M Newtson, Federico Aguayo, Jurgita Malaiškienė
pmc-11478107.description: Extensive research has been conducted on the sulfate attack of concrete structures; however, the need to adopt the use of more sustainable materials is driving a need for a quicker test method to assess sulfate resistance. This work presents accelerated methods that can reduce the time required for assessing the sulfate resistance of mixtures by 70%.

pmc-11480980.title: Quantum Chemical Characterization of Rotamerism in Thio-Michael Additions for Targeted Covalent Inhibitors
pmc-11480980.creator: Shayantan Chaudhuri, David M. Rogers, Christopher J. Hayes, Katherine Inzani, Jonathan D. Hirst
pmc-11480980.description: Myotonic dystrophy type I (DM1) is the most common form of adult muscular dystrophy and is a severe condition with no treatment currently available. Recently, small-molecule ligands have been developed as targeted covalent inhibitors that have some selectivity for and covalently inhibit cyclin-dependent kinase 12 (CDK12).

pmc-11629525.title: O010 Sleep duration and timing predict next-day exercise likelihood and duration: an analysis of 6-million person-nights
pmc-11629525.creator: J Leota, F Le, D Presby, M Czeisler, H Scott, E Capodilupo, S Drummond, S Rajaratnam, E Facer-Childs
pmc-11629525.description: IntroductionSleep and exercise are pillars of health. However, the temporal dynamics between these two behaviours remain poorly understood. This study examined the independent between- and within-person associations of sleep duration and onset on next-day exercise likelihood and duration in a large, longitudinal sample of adults under free-living conditions.

pmc-11677636.title: PPP2R5D-Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder and Multiple Haemangiomas: A Novel Phenotypic Trait?
pmc-11677636.creator: Francesco Comisi, Consolata Soddu, Francesco Lai, Monica Marica, Michela Lorrai, Giancarlo Mancuso, Sabrina Giglio, Salvatore Savasta, Erich Rutz
pmc-11677636.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Houge-Janssens syndrome 1 is a condition with onset in early childhood caused by heterozygous pathogenic variants in the PPP2R5D gene, which encodes a B56 regulatory subunit of the serine/threonine protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A). There is evidence that the PP2A-PPP2R5D complex is involved in regulating the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K)/AKT signalling pathway, which is crucial for several cellular processes, including the pathogenesis and progression of haemangiomas.

pmc-11678138.title: The Role of Phytochemicals in Managing Neuropathic Pain: How Much Progress Have We Made?
pmc-11678138.creator: Aleksandar Sic, Aarish Manzar, Nebojsa Nick Knezevic
pmc-11678138.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Neuropathic pain is a complex and debilitating condition resulting from nerve damage, characterized by sensations such as burning, tingling, and shooting pain. It is often associated with conditions such as multiple sclerosis (MS), Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS), and diabetic polyneuropathy. Conventional pain therapies frequently provide limited relief and are accompanied by significant side effects, emphasizing the need to explore alternative treatment options.

pmc-12661157.title: Adapting a commercial sample extraction protocol for biosafety level 3/4 compatible plasma metabolomics analysis
pmc-12661157.creator: J Brandsma, JW Thompson, KL Schully, JG Chenoweth, P Genzor, S Krishnan, DA Striegel, LSt John-Williams, A Moseley, G Oduro, N Adams, T Vantha, EL Tsalik, CW Woods, DV Clark
pmc-12661157.description: Highlights•Comparison between extraction methods for metabolomics analysis of BSL-3/4 samples.•Combining MPLEx and AbsoluteIDQ p180 protocols is a viable option for BSL-3/4 samples.•Sample dilution and extraction efficiency differ from the unmodified p180 protocol.Keywords: Metabolomics, Sample extraction, Infectious diseases, Biosafety, High-risk pathogens Introduction Sepsis is a complex, multifaceted organ dysfunction syndrome caused by a dysregulated host response to infection [1].

pmc-12773373.title: Abstract 070: Door in‐door out time for stroke thrombectomy transfers in a large hub‐and‐spoke network
pmc-12773373.creator: Rashid A Ahmed, Joyce A McIntyre, Thabele M Leslie‐Mazwi, Alvin S Das, Adam A Dmytriw, Joshua A Hirsch, James D Rabinov, Omer Doron, Christopher J Stapleton, Aneesh B Singhal, Natalia S Rost, Aman B Patel, Robert W Regenhardt
pmc-12773373.description: IntroductionThe mantra ‘time is brain’ cannot be overstated for patients suffering from acute ischemic stroke. This is especially true for those with large vessel occlusions (LVO) requiring transfer to an endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) capable center. We sought to evaluate the spoke hospital door in‐door out (DIDO) times for patients transferred to our hub center for EVT.

pmc-13015250.title: Metabolic orchestration of NOD1 signaling by AMPK-mediated phosphorylation of ZDHHC5
pmc-13015250.creator: Shaojie Mi, Yue Zhu, Qian Li, Wanjun Zhang, Huadong Pei, Feng Yao, Xuewu Guo, Yali Chen
pmc-13015250.description: SummaryInnate immune responses must be coordinated with the cellular metabolic state. The intracellular pattern recognition receptor NOD1 detects bacterial peptidoglycans and initiates signaling from cellular membranes, a process regulated by ZDHHC5-mediated palmitoylation. Using biochemical analyses and immune-competent cell models, we show that AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) integrates metabolic cues into NOD1 signaling by regulating ZDHHC5.

pmc-13439898.title: Evaluating emergency management capabilities and identifying their related factors for public health emergencies in China
pmc-13439898.creator: Li Yuan, Gan Xiaocheng, Zhang Kexin, Zhang Qianxi, Xie Yuan
pmc-13439898.description: Enhancing public health emergency management capability is an urgent governance challenge for China’s provinces. To address this, this study develops a theoretical evaluation system comprising four dimensions: prevention and monitoring, emergency processing, emergency response, and recovery and reconstruction. Within this framework, particular attention is paid to measuring each province's capacity for emergency resource reserves and foundational support conditions.
